name: How do Colorado weather extremes affect home restoration in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: How do Colorado weather extremes affect home restoration in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Properties in the Denver metro area face freeze-thaw cycles, heavy spring snowfalls, and severe summer hail, which often lead to hidden water intrusions behind exterior siding and around roof valleys. When restoring interior walls and ceilings in this climate, addressing the exterior failure point is essential before closing walls. Crews must ensure proper framing insulation, inspect for ice-dam leaks, and verify that framing is completely dry during winter months before hanging new drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver's rapid freeze-thaw cycles and hail cause hidden leaks that require inspecting exterior entry points and thoroughly drying cold framing before drywalling.
